function: DNN estimates the mMIMO-SEFDM channel from received pilots and signals; vector-quantized CSI feedback then sets compression factor and modulation order (p. 2, 5)
system: Single-cell mMIMO-SEFDM, 128 BS transmit antennas, K single-antenna users, 512 subcarriers, TDD, ZF beamforming, Nakagami-m fading; no RIS; carrier frequency not stated (p. 3, 8)
method: Multilayer DNN (L = 5; 128, 1024, 512, 256, 128 neurons), supervised with MSE loss and Adam, trained offline independently per compression factor alpha (p. 5)
data_channel: Custom MATLAB simulation of Nakagami-m fading (m = 0.3, 0.4, 0.5); 432,000 generated samples split 80/10/10% into training, validation, test (p. 8)
test_conditions: Same generated dataset for training and testing (80/10/10 split) over alpha 0.9, 0.8, 0.7, three modulations, m = 0.3-0.5; one DNN trained per alpha (p. 5, 8)
baselines: Non-learned: linear MMSE channel estimation for SEFDM; plain OFDM (alpha = 1) as benchmark. No earlier learned estimator is compared (p. 9)
metrics: Channel-estimation MSE and symbol error rate versus Eb/N0 (Figs. 3, 4); spectral efficiency (bps/Hz) versus SNR (p. 8, 9)
complexity: Order O(sum n_i n_{i+1}) over neurons per layer, called linear; contrasted with ML O(M^K N), MMSE O(N_F^3), sphere decoding O(2^n); no runtime (p. 7)
q1_support: p. 3: "adopts the Nakagami-m"; custom MATLAB simulator (p. 8: "conducted using MATLAB 2023(b)"); no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO, or measured channel is used.
q2_support: p. 8: "validation, and 10% for testing"; test data is a held-out part of the same generated data, and p. 5: "Training the model independently for each" alpha, so no new condition is tested.
q3_support: p. 9: "outperforms traditional linear"; only the linear MMSE baseline and OFDM are compared (Fig. 4(b)); no earlier learned estimator is compared, the learned works cited on p. 2 appear only in the introduction.
q4_support: p. 7: "the proposed DNN-based detection achieves linear"; p. 7: "where ni represents the neurons per layer"; the order of complexity given for the proposed DNN is O(sum n_i n_{i+1}).
q5_support: p. 8: "conducted using MATLAB 2023(b)"; the data are generated by the authors and the paper gives no link, DOI, or release statement for code or data, and uses no public dataset.
notes: Included, area 2: the learned element is the DNN channel estimator trained with the channel MSE loss (Eq. 8, p. 5). CSI feedback is non-learned vector quantization and the choice of compression factor and modulation is threshold-based (Algorithm 1, p. 6). The BS has 128 antennas (p. 8), so the single-antenna exclusion does not apply. The complexity section calls the DNN detection although the method is a channel estimator (p. 7). Page numbers count PDF pages.
